name: ecommerce-reporting-filament
description: The operator's view of a reported number: what each definition asks and who answers it, what every run computed and what it refused and why, and which subscriptions have gone undelivered.
features: A definition a run could not obtain renders its refusal and its reason, never a nought and never an empty cell
All six refusal reasons the domain publishes have a sentence, and a new one is a hole in a match rather than a blank on a screen
The stats widget carries one entry per definition the newest run touched, and a refused definition's entry is the reason rather than a zero with an arrow beside it
Every widget states the tenant in its own query, because a widget is the surface Filament's own tenancy does not reach and canView defaults to true
Both widgets are constructed by the suite, which is the test the host never had and the reason its store-scoped widget error was invisible to CI
The whole page reads the domain once through a per-request snapshot, rather than each widget resolving a service and re-running the same aggregates
One clock is read per request and every window comes from it, so a page rendered across midnight cannot report two different windows
Every figure is shown beside the window it covers, which the host's dashboard never named at all
Money is rendered in minor units and said to be, because the domain stores no exponent and inventing one here would be arithmetic this package must not do
A ratio is rendered as the two integers it was stored as, never as a percentage that clamps
The readiness screen tells a module that has never run from one whose every run failed from one with genuinely nothing to report
Each definition's source key is shown bound or unbound on the record, so an operator sees why a number is missing before a run refuses it
There is no create, edit or delete control anywhere: a definition is versioned rather than edited, and results and deliveries raise from their own deleting hooks
Defining and withdrawing a metric, computing a run and delivering it, and pausing a subscription are the published domain actions and nothing else
Custody is asked before a run id is handed on, because the domain publishes one method that takes a loaded run and does not re-check the tenant
No subject reference appears on any listing, and a redacted one renders as nobody named rather than as a blank
This panel offers neither the cross-tenant export nor the cross-tenant erasure, because a screen scoped to one merchant must not carry a control that spans every merchant
Nothing in this package writes through Eloquent: every write is a published action that takes the tenant as its first argument and re-reads its own row
Another merchant's definition, run or subscription and one that does not exist raise the same exception on every screen
Every count over a restated relation is asserted at its right non-zero value, because a guarded restatement that reports zero looks exactly like isolation working
